## History

As the schoolmaster, Mr. Phillips disciplined [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) by forcing her to stand in front of the class after she broke her slate over [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's head. He later punished her further by forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), which prompted [Anne](../character/anne.md) to temporarily leave school. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--phillips.md)

Mr. Phillips serves as Anne's schoolteacher, though their relationship is marked by severe friction. After he punishes [Anne](../character/anne.md) by forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), she becomes so deeply upset that she temporarily decides to leave school altogether. Although [Anne](../character/anne.md) later becomes emotional over Mr. Phillips's eventual departure from the school, his harsh disciplinary actions initially caused her significant distress.

- Mentor of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>

### [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phillips--prissy-andrews.md)

Mr. Phillips is romantically involved with [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), actively courting her during his time as the local schoolmaster. Their relationship continues up until Mr. Phillips's eventual departure from the school.

- Romantically involved with — courting  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001)</sub>

### [Sam](../character/sam.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phillips--sam.md)

Mr. Phillips serves in a mentorship role over [Sam](../character/sam.md) as his teacher within the local school.

- Mentor of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018)</sub>
